description: A4D-2 c/n 11386, ex USN BuNo 142132, received March 1967, retired 1986; delivered to the institute as a Malvinas monument in June 2000, repainted by AMQ November 2011. Displayed at the entrance, partly visible from Av. Tejedor García; photographed June 2018. An MS-760 also kept inside is not visible.
